verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical and both are broken. The leafy photo is reduced to a green blob at the top. The frame is now an empty box floating mid-canvas. The bulb icon and divider lines are pushed to the bottom and sit against a grey bar. The headline's first line runs nearly edge to edge with no side margin, and there are large dead areas. A is slightly less bad because its headline has more breathing room below the top blob, while B's headline is jammed against the top.
